# split

Replace the old units with the new units at unchanged total basis, then sell part of the adjusted holding. The split itself creates no realized gain.

## Calculations

All monetary amounts below are USD. These calculations explain the command expectations; they are not additional report fields.

### 2024-02-28

Intended accounting assessment: **balanced**.

| Account | Commodity | Units | Remaining basis | Market value | Market value minus basis |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Assets:Broker | FUND | 20 | 1000 | 1200 | 200 |

Purchase cost: 1000; sale proceeds: 0; separately expensed fees: 0.

Booked realized gain: 0; net realized gain after fees: 0.

Arithmetic unrealized total: 200; economic result from cash flows and market value: 200; difference: 0.
